name: Splendid Chicken 97
author: Bodyhc
description: Outlined pill indigo button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, border-radius becomes 20px, width becomes 300px, height becomes 200px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Splendid Chicken 97</title>
<style>
/* Splendid Chicken 97 by Bodyhc — https://uiverse.io/Bodyhc/splendid-chicken-97 */
button {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid #725ac1;
  outline: none;
  background-color: transparent;
  padding: 15px 30px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  z-index: 2;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: #ffff;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-family: "Franklin Gothic Medium", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif;
}

button::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 20%;
  left: 20%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  background-color: #725ac1;
  filter: blur(5px);
  z-index: -1;
  transition: width 0.9s ease-out, height 0.9s ease-out,
    background-color 0.3s ease-out;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

button:hover::before {
  border-radius: 20px;
  width: 300px;
  height: 200px;
  background-color: #725ac1;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Button</button>

</body>
</html>
